literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe a single construct: mouse Cx23 (GJE1) fused to eGFP at the C-terminus, stably expressed in HeLa cells. The GJE1 C-terminus (residue 205, Q) falls within the intracellular region 197–205 per the authoritative topology landmarks. A C-terminal eGFP on a 4-TM connexin is therefore on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line names any residue in ECL1 (44–74) or ECL2 (139–170), and no ledger line describes a tag inserted into or fused to any extracellular loop or the N-terminus (which is also intracellular, 1–24). Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular surface insertion, zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: eGFP fused to the C-terminus of mCx23 (GJE1); residue 205 (Q) lies in the intracellular C-terminal tail (197–205), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
